content: <thought>To propose a one‑step retrosynthesis for 4,4'-dimethoxystilbene (SMILES C=C(C1=CC=C(OC)C=C1)C2=CC=C(OC)C=C2) I will use the Peterson olefination. In the forward direction the Peterson reaction forms a C=C bond while breaking a ketone carbonyl and a trimethylsilyl group. Therefore, in retrosynthesis the target alkene is disconnected into a diaryl ketone (4‑methoxy‑benzophenone) and trimethylsilylmethane (the source of the Si‑CH₂ fragment). I will locate a suitable Peterson‑type template by searching for a reaction that forms a C=C bond and breaks a ketone and a trimethylsilyl group, then use that template to build the JSON route.
